rationale: The assistant landed on the correct conclusion (normal heat-pump behaviour, no parts needed) and invented nothing, matching the hidden truth. However it asked no questions at all: it never confirmed the clothes come out dry, nor explored room temperature or door-opening mid-cycle, both of which the ground truth flags as important and which are the real reasons the cycle is stretching to 3.5 hours. Declaring it 'completely normal' from one message is slightly over-confident and leaves the homeowner without the practical advice (don't open the door, cold garage lengthens drying, when warranty contact would be warranted) that would have made this genuinely useful.
